claim_boundary: All cohort equations with certified lower bound at least27 and no match among the pinned593 catalogue and853 prior equations, with integral equations and exactly transported independent points. A minimality claim is made only when its separate certificate says PROVED_GLOBAL_MINIMAL. Exact ranks, conductors, full saturation, records and universal novelty remain unproved.

certificate.argument: A nonminimal integral model at p requires v_p(c4)>=4, v_p(c6)>=6 and v_p(discriminant)>=12. Each gcd prime either fails those valuations or has no integral model with scaled invariants c4/p^4,c6/p^6. Every p-integral Weierstrass equation admits p-integral translations normalizing a1,a3 to0 or1 and a2 to-1,0 or1: choose s using residues modulo2 when p=2 (otherwise2 is a unit), r using residues modulo3 when p=3 (otherwise3 is a unit), then t using residues modulo2. For each of these12 triples c4,c6 uniquely determine a4,a6 by the displayed b-invariant equations. A coefficient with denominator divisible by p in every candidate exclude a smaller integral model. Primes outside the gcd are excluded by invariant valuations.

rank_certificate_on_discovery_curve.argument: Every integral relation is divisible by 2; E(Q)[2]=0 permits infinite descent. Hence all listed points are independent.
